title: "Accepted in Ecological Economics: Assessing the Socio-Economic Impact of the Circular Economy"
date: 2026-09-30
categories: [Academic]
description: "The NICE circular-economy paper, first circulated as a UNIDO working paper, has been accepted in Ecological Economics and is forthcoming in 2026."
---

Accepted in *Ecological Economics* and forthcoming in 2026, with Manuel Albaladejo, Nicola Cantore, Alessandro Flammini, Giovanni Marin and Massimiliano Mazzanti:

"Assessing the Socio-Economic Impact of the Circular Economy through Input-Output Modelling: Evidence from Developing Countries" introduces NICE (National Impacts of Circular Economy), an input-output based method for assessing how circular-economy interventions affect economic and social outcomes in developing countries. The paper was first circulated as a UNIDO working paper.
